capabilities: Gather checkbox tasks from any Markdown file in the vault
Plan tasks across time horizons by drag-and-drop
Write status, due date, and tag changes back to the source task
Track task statuses and priority values
Expand @ shortcuts and pick due dates while editing task lines
extras: Licensed under GPL v2.0; desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or newer as of version 2.2.0. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: It is based on Proletarian Wizard by cfe84 and contributors, also licensed under GPL v2.0.
problem: Tasks written as checkboxes are scattered across vault notes with no way to plan them by day or horizon or see overdue work in one place.

summary: Task-planning board that gathers Markdown checkbox tasks from across the vault into drag-and-drop Today, backlog, overdue, and future horizon columns.
